review_description: We had several annoying experiences with tradesman not coming on the day stated nor providing any reason for not turning up. We had one instance when the electrician did not come but his offsider told us he would come the following Monday. The company had not informed us of this.On the plus side the installation is working well and the installed equipment is top quality.
The actual size of my system will be 2.5 kW with the cost being just under $7000.
